cases.why: the seed is taken and not used, so every night runs the same thirty cases and the rest of the corpus is never run again -- the failure this workflow exists to prevent, with a green run every morning
a slice with no seed is a slice nobody can reproduce: a failure in it is a report with no way to re-run it
the run summary shows the table without the list of cases that were not caught, so a red night says how many and not which

cases.why: the workflow passes a constant seed, so the same slice runs every night
